slides.body: Technically it’s a list of Facebook groups so far, I haven’t started on a list of Facebook pages. Are you going to make a Facebook group to match that Facebook Page? The big difference is that with pages, the page owner’s posts dominate, but with groups it’s a free for all and any group member can potentially dominate the conversation with a popular post.
